name: berean
description: Digest-pinned agent releases with byte-exact citations, block-bound reads and evaluated refusals.

interface.shortDescription: Digest-pinned agent releases with byte-exact citations, block-bound reads and evaluated refusals.
interface.longDescription: Berean releases evidence-backed protocol agents. A release pins its corpus by digest, proves every citation as exact bytes, binds every live value to a chain and block, separates document claims from chain readings, states when it refuses, and records the evaluation that made it active. The verifier checks all of that offline, without the model that produced the answers.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $berean to verify this release's citations, chain readings and promotion record against its pinned corpus.
